```{=html}
<style>
.pb-hero-demo { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 1.6rem; margin: 1.2rem 0 0.6rem 0; }
.pb-hero-prompt { font-family: "Libre Baskerville", Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 600; color: #374151; border: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
.pb-hero-prompt span { font-weight: 900; color: #000; text-decoration: underline; min-height: 1em; display: inline-block; min-width: 1px; }
.pb-hero-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4rem; }
.pb-raccoon { width: 11rem; height: 11rem; cursor: none; }
.pb-stim { width: 5.5rem; height: 5.5rem; position: relative; align-self: center; }
.pb-stim-layer { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  transition: transform 0.5s ease-in-out, opacity 0.5s ease-in-out; }
.pb-stim-layer img { max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; }
@media (max-width: 639px) {
  .pb-hero-prompt, .pb-stim { display: none; }
  .pb-raccoon { cursor: default; }
}
</style>

<script>
(function () {
  // ---- assets & pairs (identical to the Astro site's gallery.jsx) ----
  const S = "images/stimuli/";
  const pairs = [
    { word: "elephant", left: S + "goat.svg",   right: S + "elephant.svg" },
    { word: "cookie",   left: S + "cookie.png", right: S + "dog.png" },
    { word: "duck",     left: S + "duck.png",   right: S + "goat.svg" },
    { word: "dog",      left: S + "dog.png",    right: S + "saw.svg" },
    { word: "pencil",   left: S + "pencil.png", right: S + "saw.svg" },
    { word: "bird",     left: S + "cookie.png", right: S + "bird.png" },
    { word: "car",      left: S + "car.png",    right: S + "table.png" },
    { word: "table",    left: S + "table.png",  right: S + "saw.svg" },
    { word: "goat",     left: S + "goat.svg",   right: S + "pencil.png" },
    { word: "cat",      left: S + "cat.png",    right: S + "saw.svg" },
  ];

  const isSmall = () => window.innerWidth < 640;

  // ---- raccoon eye tracking (identical geometry to raccoon.jsx) ----
  const SVG_DIM = 184.803;
  const svg = document.getElementById("pb-raccoon-svg");
  const eyes = [
    { cx: 59.52, cy: 109.735, max: 5.0,
      pupil: document.getElementById("pb-pupil-left"),
      highlight: document.getElementById("pb-highlight-left") },
    { cx: 125.283, cy: 109.736, max: 5.0,
      pupil: document.getElementById("pb-pupil-right"),
      highlight: document.getElementById("pb-highlight-right") },
  ];

  function highlightPath(tx, ty) {
    const x = tx - 2, y = ty - 2;
    return `M${x + 4.347},${y - 2.174}c0,2.754-2.526,2.174-2.174,2.174` +
      `c-1.2,0-2.173-0.974-2.173-2.174c0-1.2,0.973-2.174,2.173-2.174` +
      `C${x + 3.374},${y - 4.347},${x + 4.347},${y - 3.374},${x + 4.347},${y - 2.174}z`;
  }

  function setEye(eye, tx, ty) {
    eye.pupil.setAttribute("cx", tx);
    eye.pupil.setAttribute("cy", ty);
    eye.highlight.setAttribute("d", highlightPath(tx, ty));
  }

  function eyesDown() {
    for (const eye of eyes) setEye(eye, eye.cx, eye.cy + eye.max);
  }

  function onMouseMove(ev) {
    if (isSmall()) return;
    const rect = svg.getBoundingClientRect();
    const sx = ((ev.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * SVG_DIM;
    const sy = ((ev.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * SVG_DIM;
    const cx = (eyes[0].cx + eyes[1].cx) / 2;
    const cy = (eyes[0].cy + eyes[1].cy) / 2;
    const dx = sx - cx, dy = sy - cy;
    const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
    const ux = dist > 0 ? dx / dist : 0;
    const uy = dist > 0 ? dy / dist : 0;
    for (const eye of eyes) setEye(eye, eye.cx + ux * eye.max, eye.cy + uy * eye.max);
  }

  document.addEventListener("mousemove", onMouseMove);
  window.addEventListener("resize", () => { if (isSmall()) eyesDown(); });
  if (isSmall()) eyesDown();

  // ---- rotating stimulus pairs + typing prompt (mirrors gallery.jsx) ----
  const wordEl = document.getElementById("pb-hero-word");
  const sides = {
    left: document.querySelectorAll("#pb-stim-left .pb-stim-layer"),
    right: document.querySelectorAll("#pb-stim-right .pb-stim-layer"),
  };

  let currentIndex = 0;
  let showLayer1 = true;
  let typingTimer = null;

  function setLayer(side, layerIdx, pair) {
    const img = sides[side][layerIdx].querySelector("img");
    img.src = side === "left" ? pair.left : pair.right;
  }

  function applyVisibility() {
    for (const side of ["left", "right"]) {
      sides[side].forEach((layer, i) => {
        const visible = (i === 0) === showLayer1;
        layer.style.transform = visible ? "scale(1)" : "scale(0)";
        layer.style.opacity = visible ? 1 : 0;
      });
    }
  }

  function typeWord(word) {
    clearTimeout(typingTimer);
    let text = "";
    function typeStep() {
      if (text.length < word.length) {
        text = word.slice(0, text.length + 1);
        wordEl.textContent = text;
        typingTimer = setTimeout(typeStep, 150);
      } else {
        typingTimer = setTimeout(eraseStep, 3000);
      }
    }
    function eraseStep() {
      if (text.length > 0) {
        text = text.slice(0, -1);
        wordEl.textContent = text;
        typingTimer = setTimeout(eraseStep, 100);
      }
    }
    typeStep();
  }

  // initial state
  setLayer("left", 0, pairs[0]);
  setLayer("right", 0, pairs[0]);
  applyVisibility();
  typeWord(pairs[0].word);

  setInterval(() => {
    if (isSmall()) return;
    const nextIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % pairs.length;
    const hiddenLayer = showLayer1 ? 1 : 0;
    setLayer("left", hiddenLayer, pairs[nextIndex]);
    setLayer("right", hiddenLayer, pairs[nextIndex]);
    currentIndex = nextIndex;
    showLayer1 = !showLayer1;
    applyVisibility();
    typeWord(pairs[nextIndex].word);
  }, 5000);
})();
</script>
```
